# Dahiana Porto

> Low-code and AI Product Builder. Started in marketing, grew into a CMO role, moved into building products with low-code tools, design, and teaching.

## Background

Dahiana Porto is a low-code and AI Product Builder. She started in marketing, became a CMO, and for the past four years has been building products with low-code tools (Bubble, Webflow, WordPress, Framer), n8n automations, and AI/agentic workflows.

## Selected work

- Built foundational product work for Yonder and The Village at [Minimum](https://www.minimum.studio/), one of the best development studios in the world.
- Created style guides, site structure, landing pages, and SEO from scratch for [Inusual](https://www.inusual.com/).
- Improved the Bubble app, documentation, and website for [Noctorial](https://noctorial.com/).
- Served as CMO and taught digital marketing classes at [KeepCoding](https://keepcoding.io/).
- Built websites with Webflow using Client First Framework for the Divino Hotels portfolio, including [GG Hostel](https://www.gghostel.com/) and Casa Lolita.
- Developed agentic workflows, AEO, and automation solutions for [Fortnight.Studio](https://www.fortnight.studio/).

## What she can help with

- Building products and MVPs with AI and Bubble.
- Creating websites and landing pages with Webflow, WordPress, or Framer.
- Building automations from scratch with n8n.
- SEO, AEO, automations, and content marketing.
